abstract: Experimental choriocarcinomas of the rat were studied with electron microscopy and compared with the ultrastructure of rat trophoblasts at mid-and late-gestational stage. The choriocarcinoma numbered m-803 contained abundant cytoplasmic organellae and was quite similar to the trophospongial cell at late-gestational stage. The M-801 closely resembled the trophospongial cell at mid-gestational stage. The m-673, which has 3-beta-ol dehydrogenase enzyme system, could not be studied sufficiently inspite of the examination of more than 30 blocks of epon embedded specimen, because of the degeneration and necrosis occurring in the specimens.
abstract_ja: 実験的ラット絨毛癌を電子顕微鏡で観察し、妊娠中期および後期のラット栄養膜細胞と超微細構造を比較した。株m-803は細胞質内小器官が豊富で、妊娠後期の栄養海綿状細胞によく似ていた。M-801は妊娠中期の栄養海綿状細胞によく似ていた。3β-ol脱水素酵素系を有するm-673は、エポン包埋標本30ブロック以上を検索したにもかかわらず、変性と壊死のため十分に検討できなかった。
